entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments:
CHAP. XXIII. 
 
  V. 1. Ruler-With a great man.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: V. 2. Put a knife-Restrain thine appetite, as if a man stood with a knife at thy throat.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: V. 3. Deceitful-They do not yield thee that satisfaction which thou didst expect from them.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: V. 4. Thine own wisdom-From worldly wisdom, which persuades men to use all possible means to get riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: V. 5. Set thine eyes-Look upon it with earnestness and desire. Is not-Which has no solid and settled being.  Eagle-Swiftly, strongly, and irrecoverably.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: V. 6. Evil eye-Of the envious or covetous man.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: V. 7. So is he-You are not to judge of him by his words, but by the constant temper of his mind.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: V. 8. Vomit up-When thou perceivest his churlish disposition, his meat will be loathsome to thee.  Sweet words-Thy pleasant discourse wherewith thou didst design to delight and profit him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: V. 9. Of a fool-Cast not away good counsels upon incorrigible sinners.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: V. 10. Enter not-To possess their lands.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: V. 11. Redeemer-Heb. their near kinsman, to whom it belongs to avenge their wrongs, and to recover and maintain their rights.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: V. 13. Shall not die-It is a likely way to prevent his destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: V. 16. My reins-I shall rejoice with all my soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: V. 18. An end-An expected and happy end for such as fear God.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: V. 19. Guide-Order the whole course of thine affections and actions. In the way-In God's way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: V. 23. Buy-Purchase it upon any terms, spare no pains or cost. Truth-The true and saving knowledge of God's will.  Sell it not-Do not forsake it for any worldly advantage.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: V. 26. Give me-Solomon here speaks in God's name.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: V. 30. Mixt wine-Either mixed with water, or with other ingredients to make it strong and delicious.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: V. 31. Red-Which was the colour of the best wines in that country. Aright-When it sparkles, and seems to smile upon a man.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: V. 34. Lieth down-To sleep.  Sea-In a ship in the midst of the sea.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: V. 35. Sick-I was not sensible of it.  Again-At present my condition requires sleep to settle myself, and when I am composed, I purpose to return to my former course.
